item.fangs_n_claws.totem_of_frost.toolti: §7When held, activates at ≤25% health: fully heals and freezes all nearby enemies
jei.fangs_n_claws.owlbear: The Owlbear roams forests and taigas (surface only). Feed a baby Owlbear salmon to tame it; a tamed baby behaves like a cat, sitting down to sleep. Each piece of Owlbear armor grants hidden Feather Falling, and the chestplate lets you flap and glide.
jei.fangs_n_claws.shrike: A frost-touched Owlbear that spawns in snowy forests and snowy taigas. It fights mostly at range, loosing volleys of feathers and unleashing a freezing blizzard that pushes, slows and freezes. Shrikes drop Snow Duvet, used to upgrade Owl armor into Shrike armor.
jei.fangs_n_claws.scorpion: Scorpions spawn across the Overworld. Right-click a baby Scorpion to tame it; it then rides on your head (sneak to dismount). A baby raised while tamed grows into an adult you can ride with a Sturdy Saddle: it has no jump but climbs walls. Heal a tamed Scorpion with Chitin.
jei.fangs_n_claws.desert_scorpion: The Desert Scorpion spawns in desert biomes during the day. Like all scorpions, a tamed one can be ridden with a Sturdy Saddle and healed with Chitin.
jei.fangs_n_claws.frost_scorpion: The Frost Scorpion spawns in snowy biomes. Like all scorpions, a tamed one can be ridden with a Sturdy Saddle and healed with Chitin.
jei.fangs_n_claws.nether_scorpion: The Nether Scorpion spawns in the Crimson Forest and Nether Wastes. Like all scorpions, a tamed one can be ridden with a Sturdy Saddle and healed with Chitin.
jei.fangs_n_claws.giant_feather: Dropped by Owlbears. Used to craft the Owl armor set and Velocity Arrows.
jei.fangs_n_claws.snow_duvet: Dropped by Shrikes. Combined with the Shrike Upgrade Smithing Template to turn Owl armor into Shrike armor. The chestplate is upgraded with an Elytra instead of Snow Duvet.
jei.fangs_n_claws.chitin: Dropped by Scorpions. Used to craft Scorpion armor and to heal tamed Scorpions.
jei.fangs_n_claws.fur: Dropped by Wild Wolves. Used to craft the Fur armor set, which protects against cold.
jei.fangs_n_claws.shrike_upgrade_templat: Smithing template that upgrades Owl armor into Shrike armor. Helmet, leggings and boots are upgraded with Snow Duvet; the chestplate with an Elytra. Craft the template from Snow Duvet and Diamond.
jei.fangs_n_claws.heavy_claw: Dropped by Owlbears, Shrikes and Werewolves. Used to craft the Catching Claw.
jei.fangs_n_claws.long_fang: Dropped by Werewolves. Used to craft the Fang Dagger and the Bear Trap.
jei.fangs_n_claws.scorpion_sting: Dropped by Scorpions. Used to craft Poisonous Darts.
jei.fangs_n_claws.black_horn: Dropped by Hell Ogres. Used to craft the Hellfire Pitchfork.
jei.fangs_n_claws.spectral_essence: Dropped by Ghosts and Fire Ghosts. Used to craft the Ghost Block.
jei.fangs_n_claws.vile_fat: Dropped by Ogres. Smelts into a Slime Ball, can be used as furnace fuel, and is used to craft the Vile Lantern.
jei.fangs_n_claws.blowgun: Fires Poisonous Darts. Hold to charge, release to shoot — a longer charge sends the dart faster and farther.
jei.fangs_n_claws.poisonous_dart: Ammunition for the Blowgun. Applies Venom to whatever it hits. Crafted from Scorpion Sting.
jei.fangs_n_claws.fang_dagger: A fast, light blade. Striking a target from behind inflicts Bleeding. Crafted from Long Fang.
jei.fangs_n_claws.netherite_dagger: Upgraded Fang Dagger: backstabs inflict Bleeding II, and it is fire-resistant.
jei.fangs_n_claws.catching_claw: Grappling weapon. Fire it to hook a target, then retrieve to launch the target toward where you are aiming. Crafted from Heavy Claw.
jei.fangs_n_claws.catching_claw_netherit: Upgraded Catching Claw: fire-resistant and more durable, with the same hook-and-launch mechanic.
jei.fangs_n_claws.silver_sword: The only weapon that can effectively kill a Werewolf.
jei.fangs_n_claws.tomahawk: A throwing axe. Melee stats are 1 damage below an iron axe. Right-click to throw it (5s cooldown) - the axe stays in your inventory but each throw costs 1 durability. It spins in flight, damages the first target, then vanishes. Can also be fired from a dispenser.
jei.fangs_n_claws.enchantment.critical_b: Fang Dagger / Netherite Dagger only. Backstabs deal bonus damage, increasing with level.
jei.fangs_n_claws.enchantment.quick_kill: Fang Dagger / Netherite Dagger only. Shortens the backstab cooldown and grants a burst of Speed after a successful backstab.
jei.fangs_n_claws.enchantment.item_catch: Catching Claw / Netherite Catching Claw only. The hook can grab dropped items and reel them back to you.
jei.fangs_n_claws.enchantment.scratch: Catching Claw / Netherite Catching Claw only. Increases its melee attack damage, scaling with level.
jei.fangs_n_claws.enchantment.blazing: Fire Pitchfork / Hellfire Pitchfork only. Deals up to +2.5 bonus damage to targets that are on fire.
jei.fangs_n_claws.fire_pitchfork: Thrown like a trident. Hits inflict Flamebrand; on the 3rd stack the target explodes in flames. The explosion no longer harms the thrower.
jei.fangs_n_claws.hellfire_pitchfork: Upgraded, fire-resistant pitchfork. Inflicts Hellfire Flamebrand; the target explodes in flames on the 3rd stack. Crafted with Black Horn.
jei.fangs_n_claws.evil_eye: Thrown item. Blinds all nearby enemies on impact and instantly kills flying pests.
jei.fangs_n_claws.velocity_arrow: A special arrow fired 20% faster than normal that violently launches whatever it strikes.
jei.fangs_n_claws.ghost_block: A phantom block with no collision — you walk straight through it. Place a block inside it and the Ghost Block takes on that block's texture. Standing inside it blurs your vision. Crafted from Spectral Essence.
jei.fangs_n_claws.vile_lantern: A bright light source (light level 15) that sits on the ground or hangs, like a lantern. It repels hostile mobs within about 6 blocks, shoving them away. Crafted from Vile Fat.
jei.fangs_n_claws.bear_trap: A hidden trap. When a creature steps on it, it snaps shut, dealing 8 damage and inflicting Bleeding II for 10 seconds. Crafted with Long Fang.
jei.fangs_n_claws.sturdy_saddle: A reinforced saddle used to ride a tamed adult Scorpion as well as any of the mod's horse mobs (Horse Bat, Nightmare Horse, Zombie Horse, Skeleton Horse). A ridden Scorpion cannot jump but can climb walls.
jei.fangs_n_claws.horse_blanket: Armor for the mod's horses (Nightmare, Skeleton, Zombie Horse and Horse Bat). Equip it in their armor slot for extra protection; it also stops the horse from burning in sunlight.
jei.fangs_n_claws.totem_of_frost: When held, it activates automatically at 25% health or below: it fully heals you and freezes every nearby enemy.
jei.fangs_n_claws.scorpion_armor: Scorpion armor. Each piece grants immunity to one effect: helmet negates Nausea, chestplate negates Poison, leggings negate Venom, boots negate Hunger. Crafted from Chitin.
jei.fangs_n_claws.fur_armor: Fur armor, warm gear. Wearing Fur reduces freezing in powder snow — a full set makes you immune. The helmet makes Wild Wolves ignore you; the boots keep you from sinking into powder snow. Crafted from Fur.
jei.fangs_n_claws.owl_armor: Owl armor. Every piece grants hidden Feather Falling. The chestplate lets you flap upward (tap jump in mid-air) and glide (hold jump). Crafted from Giant Feather.
jei.fangs_n_claws.shrike_armor: Shrike armor, an upgrade of Owl armor. Hidden Feather Falling on every piece plus +20% jump and fall-cushion stats. The chestplate works as an Elytra with an upward-and-forward flap boost. Made by upgrading Owl armor with the Shrike Upgrade Smithing Template.
